scientific_integrity: All claimed parameter-uniform conclusions follow from the stated analytical proof. Exact-rational finite checking is corroboration only, not a replacement for universal quantifiers. The source supplies the word family; standard overlap, Hoeffding, and KL inequalities are acknowledged prior methods.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns coprime rotational switching words and phase-resampled two-symbol measurements with known independent bit-flip noise. It does not cover arbitrary symbolic orbits, physical time sampling from one trajectory, unknown noise, or origin-phase inference. Distinct rotation directions m and p-m yield the same necklace. Generic overlapping literature remains a publication-priority risk.
title: Sharp identifiability and noisy recovery of rotational switching itineraries
